t: Thank God: Christmas at the Keller Ranch
d: An unexpected romance develops between a no-nonsense rancher and an injured hockey player as he undergoes equine-assisted therapy.
An unlucky-in-love ranch owner feels an undeniable connection to a single father with two children who has booked her ranch for the week of Christmas.
A fiercely independent equestrian finds herself clashing with a brooding veteran, only to discover that the magic of the holiday season may be what they both need to heal their hearts.
A woman needs a miracle in order to save her family's farm and her father's legacy in time for a happy Christmas.
